summary.title: Intel® 64 and IA-32 Architectures Optimization Reference Manual Volume 1
summary.one_liner: This Intel manual explains how to optimize software for the performance characteristics of IA-32 and Intel 64 processors.
takeaways: The manual describes how to optimize software for IA-32 and Intel 64 processor performance characteristics.
This page is a download listing for Volume 1 of the manual, dated 2023-09-05 and marked as version 051 (latest).
Earlier versions 050 through 048 are also listed on the page.
The page text itself does not list the chapter contents; the listing notes that the opening chapters cover the core pipeline.
